configuration.changes: Use frozen parent C17 sources and flags in an independent verification workspace; no quantization, parameter interface, dataset, threshold or parent-workspace changes. Exit Vivado after synthesis/report, then reopen the new project in a fresh process for implementation/report; retain the cumulative three-hour tool timeout and one-heavy scheduling. Change only the implementation clock constraint; preserve parent HLS RTL.
configuration.conclusion: Compare measured frame cycles and implementation timing before selecting the final integration candidate. Review unattended section6 decisions with the user tomorrow.
